title: Structured Like a Language Model: Analysing AI as an Automated Subject

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning culturally specific names to the chatbot (e.g., 'Zhang', 'Ali', 'Maria') during interactions and qualitatively observing how the model constructs fictional backstories linked to ethnic or national backgrounds.
Using fragments of dialogue with different names to identify subtle qualitative differences in text continuations based on the assumed gender of the supplied names.
